statement: A routing-relevant CDC-propagated system-table row that a joiner missed converges within one steady-state cooldown instead of never: the steady-state catch-up driver (MembershipPublicationCoordinatorReconcile, which already pulls control_plane_publications forward on the non-write-leader deferral tick) gains a sibling sweep over the routing-relevant propagated tables — services, partitions, nodes, message_groups, tables and node_endpoints, the ones on which a stale row can strand a distributed write — behind its own 30000 ms cooldown, riding the same tick with one attempt per table and the CL-014 catch-up's default local-first/owner-fallback read policy, never the publications leader pin. Unbounded-growth tables (replica_operations, sql_transactions, sql_transaction_participants, debug_sessions, latency_groups, inter_group_latencies) are unreachable by construction, so the sweep costs at most six sequential owner reads per cooldown with no retry sleeps. GCP run 2026-08-30T15-30-04: a services row for the result-table partition tbl-d915-p1 was inserted 31 seconds after joiner ef6a6eec's one-shot join-time hydration, the leader's follow-up CDC UPDATE found no local row with no repairing event, and steady-state hydration re-read only publications, so that joiner's routing snapshot held canonicalLeaderServiceCount 0 for ten minutes and every distributed write it coordinated to the partition timed out. The publications sweep keeps its cooldown, single-table scope and leader-pinned token; leader election, readiness rules, budgets, the 60-second certification window and the 120-second barrier are unchanged. Proven deterministically through the real defer branch, the real sibling sweep and the real CL-014 hydrate: red on HEAD, green after.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The steady-state catch-up driver (MembershipPublicationCoordinatorReconcile) remains the single owner of the deferral-tick sweeps and reuses the existing CL-014 hydrate; routing snapshots, the parallel-reduce loop and the partition CDC layer are consumers and re-derive nothing.

The publications sweep keeps its 5000 ms cooldown, its exact single-table scope and its owner-RPC leader-pinned authority token; the sibling sweep never applies that pin and uses the catch-up default local-first/owner-fallback policy.

The sibling sweep rides only the existing deferral tick behind its own 30000 ms cooldown (no new timer, sleep or cadence), never throws, and hydrates the LOCAL cache only: it never writes, promotes or trims an authoritative table, and the reused CL-014 anti-entropy pass may evict cache-only rows of the six swept tables from this node own cache (B4 single-writer intact, race-guarded by evictOlderThanMs).

Leader election, readiness rules, budgets, the 60-second GCP certification window and the 120-second barrier are unchanged; nothing derives cluster-ACTIVE or READY from nodes.status, publication counts or coverage.

Proof is a deterministic witness through the real defer branch, the real sibling sweep and the real CL-014 hydrate reproducing GCP run 2026-08-30T15-30-04 (a services row landing after the one-shot hydration with its fan-out dropped), red on HEAD and green after, with the two publications-scoped controls that must stay green; no GCP run is part of the proof.
